players.product: Recursion OS, biological foundation models, and Lab-in-the-Loop drug engine

quarterly_data.signal: REC-4881 Phase 2 TUPELO data in the August 2026 corporate presentation (8-K Exhibit 99.2; 4mg QD, data cutoff 2025-11-25): 75% of evaluable patients had reduced polyp burden at Week 13 (12 weeks on drug, N=12); at Week 25, after 12 weeks off drug (N=11), median polyp burden reduction deepened to 53% with 82% of patients reduced, and 5 of 11 evaluable patients maintained or improved their reduction while off treatment. Median reduction was 52% in the upper GI (N=10) and 57% in the lower GI (N=9). Safety: 15 of 18 (84.2%) treatment-related AEs were Grade 1/2, Grade 3 in 15.8% of patients, no Grade 4/5 events, 4 discontinuations. An Amsterdam UMC registry (n=55, ~20-year follow-up) found 87% of evaluated patients had an annual polyp-burden increase.
quarterly_data.figure: Week 13: 75% of patients reduced (N=12); Week 25: 53% median reduction, 82% reduced (N=11); upper GI 52% (N=10), lower GI 57% (N=9); 84.2% of TRAEs Grade 1/2; Grade 3 in 15.8%; registry n=55, 87% with annual increase

quarterly_data.signal: REC-4881 regulatory path and catalysts (Q2 2026 results release and decks, 8-K Exhibits 99.1-99.3): discussions with FDA were initiated in 1H26 and an update to define the registrational path is expected in 2H26; TUPELO is also enrolling a cohort with an alternative dosing schedule. Updated Phase 1b/2 safety and efficacy data contextualized with real-world registry data will be presented at Presidential Plenary I of the 30th CGA-IGC Annual Meeting on November 2, 2026, and additional Phase 2 clinical data are expected in 1H27.
quarterly_data.figure: FDA discussions initiated 1H26; registrational-path update 2H26; CGA-IGC presentation November 2, 2026; additional Phase 2 data 1H27

quarterly_data.signal: REC-1245 (first-in-class oral RBM39 molecular glue degrader) early Phase 1 monotherapy dose escalation in the August 2026 corporate presentation (8-K Exhibit 99.2; data cutoff 2026-03-31): N=16 patients with advanced solid tumors (7 MSI-H and/or dMMR, 9 MSS; median 4.5 prior systemic therapy lines) across once-daily dose levels Dose 1 to Dose 4. Any treatment-related AE 10 (62.5%), Grade 1-2 9 (56.3%), Grade 3 1 (6.2%), Grade 4-5 0; no DLTs and no serious TRAEs reported. PK is dose-dependent and supports QD dosing, pharmacodynamic assessments show target engagement, and Recursion expects to achieve exposures consistent with tumor regression in mice within the next two dose levels; additional dose levels are enrolling. The candidate was reached after screening only 204 compounds.
quarterly_data.figure: N=16; any TRAE 62.5%; Grade 3 6.2%; no DLTs; 204 compounds

quarterly_data.signal: REC-7735 (PI3K-alpha H1047R) in the August 2026 decks (8-K Exhibits 99.2-99.3): the Phase 1/2 ZINNIA trial plans Phase 1A dose finding in PIK3CA-H1047R solid tumors (N = ~30), a hyperglycemia-vulnerable population (N = ~20) and Phase 1B dose optimization in ER+/HER2- breast cancer (N = ~40); combination expansion will depend on the clinical safety profile and target engagement. Preclinically it produced dose-dependent tumor regression superior or comparable to alpelisib and STX-4781 with no hyperglycemia signal. In the deck, H1047R HR+ / HER2- breast cancer across stages is put at ~47,000 patients (US + EU5), of whom ~16-21% are diabetic.
quarterly_data.figure: N = ~30 / ~20 / ~40; ~47,000 H1047R HR+ / HER2- breast cancer patients, ~16-21% diabetic
